items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: And brought in Barney Bigard and Doc Evans before he died.

ctx.x: And I talked and played more, just small remarks. That show got an Emmy, a Chicago Emmy. And there was 13 shows -- 17 shows chosen for a Chicago Emmy and only two from a non-commercial station. "Book Beat" was one and this was the other. So that opened the door for them to do more things and get management to come up with some money.

So then we started doing Chicago things, and using Chicago men to back guests. So I used different people that would play. And brought in Barney Bigard and Doc Evans before he died. Pee Wee Russell was on before he died, Jimmy McPartland Eddie Condon before he died, Bud Freeman, besides J. C. Higginbothom and Parenti and people like that.
What was the name of that series?
